description:
Offered for sale with no onward chain, this well-presented one-bedroom ground floor apartment occupies a convenient position on Cemetery Road, within the popular and well-connected Sharrow area of Sheffield.

The accommodation includes a bright and comfortable living room with ample space for both seating and dining. A contemporary fitted kitchen provides a practical and attractive workspace, complete with modern units, integrated appliances and generous storage.

The property also features a spacious double bedroom and a stylish bathroom finished with modern fittings. Its ground floor position makes the apartment easily accessible and particularly well suited to first-time buyers, professionals, couples or investors.

Residents benefit from excellent access to public transport, with regular bus services operating nearby. A wide selection of independent shops, cafés, restaurants and bars can also be found within easy reach, while Sheffield city centre and the surrounding areas are readily accessible.

Combining modern interiors, a convenient location and the advantage of no onward chain, this apartment represents an appealing opportunity for buyers seeking a low-maintenance home in a vibrant and established neighbourhood.

Anti-Money Laundering and Compliance

Successful buyers will be required to complete anti-money laundering and proof of funds checks. Our partner, CreditSafe Limited will send a secure link for you to complete the biometric checks electronically. A non-refundable fee of £40 per person will apply for these checks. Once these checks have been completed, Staves will issue a memorandum of sale to all relevant parties.
